com.dailyaiagents.federation.full_description: Walks every skill directory in skills/ and ~/.openclaw/skills/, validates each has SOUL.md (voice ≥75), SKILL.md, run.sh (executable), and a launchd plist OR an "on-call" marker. Outputs a coverage report listing missing pieces. Run weekly + on-demand.
